item.title: What Is the Difference Between Doubt and Unbelief?
item.description: If you’ve lived the Christian life very long as a believer, you know that every Christian, at some point or another, has that moment where they wonder whether the things they believe are really true.

item.title: 5 Questions to Help You Disciple Your Children Out of Their Spiritual Blindness
item.description: Your children are spiritually blind—and they don’t know it. Your calling as a parent is to speak into their darkness with words to try to help them see what they don’t.

item.title: 5 Ways Pastors Can Grow in Their Preaching
item.description: No one can create an effective Bible preacher. No process of training can ensure the quality of the end product because preaching involves many different aspects of mind and personality.

item.title: What Francis Grimké Would Say to the Church Today About Racial Prejudice
item.description: Francis Grimké would have a lot that he would want us to know about racial prejudice. He preached prolifically on this topic and had so many thoughts.

item.title: How Psalm 51 Led My Friend to Christ
item.description: Sharing the gospel can be intimidating. If we’re honest, we’ll admit that fear of rejection often leads us to conjure up all sorts of reasons to avoid gospel conversations with unbelievers.

item.title: Even in Your Groaning, Remember That the Lord Will Restore All Things
item.description: The Bible is punctuated with promises of restoration. They assure you that restoration is written into God’s unshakable redemptive plan.

item.title: What Is the Sabbath?
item.description: In a lifetime of “anxious toil,” we need a regular reset. Day after day, the tasks just keep coming, and while the Bible affirms the goodness of work, it also acknowledges its frustrations.

item.title: How (and How Not) to Fast
item.description: At times, the Bible is heavy on warnings. That’s the case for the topic of fasting. It can be frustrating to those of us who want a straightforward instruction manual for this spiritual discipline.

item.title: Podcast: A Beginner’s Guide to Fasting (Cassie Achermann)
item.description: Cassie Achermann discusses what fasting is, how the Bible talks about it, and how you can begin to practice it.
